proposals.before: Emperor Muzong, Filial, Peaceful, Reverent, and Upright, whose personal name was Jing and whose courtesy name was Shulü.
proposals.after: Emperor Muzong, Filial, Peaceful, Reverent, and Upright, whose personal name was Jing and whose childhood name was Shulü.
proposals.reason: 小字 means childhood/pet name, not courtesy name (字).

proposals.after: Emperor Muzong, Filial, Peaceful, Reverent, and Upright — personal name Jing, childhood name Shulü.

proposals.before: In the ninth month, on bingchen day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys to report the attack.
proposals.after: In the ninth month, on bingshen day, as Zhou invaded Han, Han sent envoys to report the attack.
proposals.reason: 丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen (丙辰).

proposals.before: In the ninth month, on bingchen day, Han, invaded by the people of Zhou, sent envoys to report it.
proposals.after: In the ninth month, on bingshen day, Han, invaded by the people of Zhou, sent envoys to report it.
proposals.reason: 丙申 is bingshen, not bingchen (丙辰).

proposals.before: That autumn, in the seventh month on gengchen day, the ruler of Han fell ill and sent envoys to announce it.
proposals.after: That autumn, in the ninth month on gengchen day, the ruler of Han fell ill and sent envoys to announce it.
proposals.reason: Chinese 九月 is the ninth month; translation wrongly says seventh month.

proposals.before: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengchen day, the Han ruler fell ill and sent envoys to report it.
proposals.after: In the ninth month of autumn, on gengchen day, the Han ruler fell ill and sent envoys to report it.
proposals.reason: Chinese 九月 is the ninth month; translation wrongly says seventh month.

proposals.before: That winter, in the eleventh month, on renchen day, the Biegude brought tribute.
proposals.after: That winter, in the eleventh month, on renyin day, the Biegude brought tribute.
proposals.reason: 壬寅 is renyin, not renchen (壬辰).

proposals.before: In the eleventh month of winter, on day renchen, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
proposals.after: In the eleventh month of winter, on day renyin, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
proposals.reason: 壬寅 is renyin, not renchen (壬辰).

decisions.reason: s0002 has 小字述律; 小字 is a childhood/pet name, not a courtesy name (字), so replacing 'courtesy name' with 'childhood name' corrects a real terminological error.
The same 小字述律 governs the literal field; 'courtesy name' misreads 小字 as 字, and 'childhood name' is the accurate rendering.
s0078 dates the event 九月丙申; 丙申 is bingshen, whereas bingchen would be 丙辰, so the proposed day name matches the Chinese.
The literal likewise must follow 丙申 as bingshen, not bingchen (丙辰).
s0089 opens 秋九月庚辰; 九月 is the ninth month, so the original 'seventh month' is a factual mistranslation and the proposed ninth month is correct.
The literal must likewise render 九月 as the ninth month of autumn, not the seventh.
s0101 has 冬十一月壬寅; 壬寅 is renyin, whereas renchen would be 壬辰, so the replacement day name is accurate.
The same 壬寅 requires renyin in the literal field; renchen (壬辰) is the wrong stem-branch reading.
